snippet.title: Flee The Fallen, A 2D Action Packed Metroidvania
snippet.description:
Introducing Flee The Fallen — a thrilling 2D zombie survival game where every second tests your reflexes, strategy, and will to survive. Battle relentless undead, switch between powerful weapons, and fight through intense encounters in a world overrun by chaos.

Developed by the talented team at AM Playhouse (Avi & Akshat Malviya) and proudly published by GameEon Studios.

👉 Wishlist & download the free demo on Steam today:
🔗 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3771610/Flee_the_fallen/

This marks one of the 5 games we’ll be publishing this year as part of our very first publishing lot — with 3 games announced and 2 more still to come. This is just the beginning of our publishing journey, and we’re excited to grow, learn, and bring you more amazing gaming experiences.

🔥 Stay tuned for more updates on Flee The Fallen and other upcoming titles from GameEon Publishing!

#FleeTheFallen #GameEonStudios #ZombieSurvival #IndieGames #GameTrailer
